question: In Garry's Mod Lua, what does cam.Start3D do?
answer:
Sets up a new 3D rendering context. Must be finished by cam.End3D .

For more advanced settings such as an orthographic view, use cam.Start instead, which this is an alias of basically.

All parameters are optional, and fall back parameters that of the "current" or "last" render operation.

Negative x/y values won't work.

This will not update current view properties.

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- pos: Vector. Render cam position.
- angles: Angle. Render cam angles.
- fov: number. Field of view.
- x: number. X coordinate of where to start the new view port.
- y: number. Y coordinate of where to start the new view port.
- w: number. Width of the new viewport.
- h: number. Height of the new viewport.
- zNear: number. Distance to near clipping plane.
Both `zNear` and `zFar` need a value before any of them work.

zNear also requires a value higher than 0.
- zFar: number. Distance to far clipping plane.

Notes
- Both `zNear` and `zFar` need a value before any of them work.

zNear also requires a value higher than 0.

Example

Set up a 3D rendering environment in a 2D rendering hook to render models on HUD.
```lua
hook.Add( "HUDPaint", "3d_camera_example", function()
cam.Start3D()
for id, ply in ipairs( player.GetAll() ) do
ply:DrawModel()
end
cam.End3D()
end )
```

```lua
hook.Add( "HUDPaint", "3d_camera_example", function()
cam.Start3D()
for id, ply in ipairs( player.GetAll() ) do
ply:DrawModel()
end
cam.End3D()
end )
```

function CUTTALEVEL:PlayerLoad()
net.Start(CUTTALEVEL_NETNAME.."playerload")
net.SendToServer()
end

function CUTTALEVEL:PlayerServerLoaded(ply,table_)
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = {} end
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = CUTTALEVEL:NormalizePlayerDataTable(table_)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Menu_refresh_objective_list(tab,questname)
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame then
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab] then
if IsValid(cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list) then
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list:Clear()
local objectives_list_scrollbar = vgui.Create("cutta_quest_system_scrollpanel",cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list)
local pnllistcolor = {}
if LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname] then
if LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"] then
for k,v in pairs(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"]) do
--cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list:AddLine(v.Obj_Name,k)
local objectives_list_panel = vgui.Create("Button",objectives_list_scrollbar)
objectives_list_panel:Dock(TOP)
objectives_list_panel:DockMargin(0,0,0,5)
objectives_list_panel:SetText(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"](""))
objectives_list_panel.Paint = function(pan,w,h)
--draw.SimpleText(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"]("Objectives"),"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",w*0.5,h*0.5,Color(255,255,255),TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER,TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
objectives_list_panel.Paint = function(pan,w,h)
draw.RoundedBox(0,0,0,w,h,Color(5,59,17))
if pnllistcolor[pan] then
draw.RoundedBox(0,0,0,w,h,pnllistcolor[pan])
end
draw.SimpleText(k..": "..v.Obj_Name,"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",0,h*0.5,Color(255,255,255),TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT,TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
if pan:IsHovered() then
draw.RoundedBox(0,0,0,w,h,Color(9,94,27,100))
end
end
end
objectives_list_panel.DoClick = function()
local Dmenuo = DermaMenu()
local orderchangeoption = Dmenuo:AddSubMenu("Change Order")
if LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"] then
if table.Count(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"]) > 0 then
for i=1,table.Count(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"]) do
orderchangeoption:AddOption(tostring(i),function()
local objtable = LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"][k]
table.remove(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"],k)
table.insert(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"],i,objtable)
cutta_quest_system:Menu_refresh_objective_list(tab,questname)
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame then
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame:Remove()
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame = nil
end
end)
end
end
end
if v.Obj_Name != "stopmusiccue" then
Dmenuo:AddOption(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"]("Edit"),function()
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list.LastEdited = k
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list.LastEditedColor = Color(0,0,0,190)
pnllistcolor[objectives_list_panel] = Color(0,0,0,190)
cutta_quest_system:Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit(cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list_actions_Frame,v.Obj_Name,questname,k)

end)
end

Dmenuo:AddOption(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"]("Duplicate"),function()
local objectivetablecopy = table.Copy(v)
table.insert(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"],objectivetablecopy)
cutta_quest_system:Menu_refresh_objective_list(tab,questname)
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame then
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame:Remove()
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame = nil
end
end)

Dmenuo:AddOption(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"]("Remove"),function()
table.remove(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Objectives"],k)
cutta_quest_system:Menu_refresh_objective_list(tab,questname)
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame then
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame:Remove()
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame = nil
end
end)

Dmenuo:Open()
end
if cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list.LastEdited == k then
pnllistcolor[objectives_list_panel] = cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].Quest_objectives_list.LastEditedColor

function cutta_quest_system:Menu_Objective_DescriptionEntry(frame,value,index,questname)
local dtextentry_coloredbackground = vgui.Create("DPanel",frame)
dtextentry_coloredbackground:Dock(TOP)
dtextentry_coloredbackground:SetBackgroundColor(Color(0,0,0,0))

local textEntry1 = vgui.Create("DTextEntry", dtextentry_coloredbackground)
textEntry1:Dock(FILL)
textEntry1:DockMargin(0,5,0,0)
textEntry1:SetPlaceholderText(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"]("Objective Message (Optional)"))
textEntry1:SetPaintBackground( false )
textEntry1:SetFont( "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small" )
textEntry1:SetTextColor(Color(255,255,255))
textEntry1.OnGetFocus = function(self)
dtextentry_coloredbackground:SetBackgroundColor(Color(58,49,49,101))

textEntry1.OnLoseFocus = function(self)
dtextentry_coloredbackground:SetBackgroundColor(Color(0,0,0,0))

end
end
end
end
end

function ADDON:NormalizeString(value, fallback)
if type(value) ~= "string" then
return fallback or ""
end

value = string.Trim(value)

if value == "" then
return fallback or ""
end

return value
end

config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSound = ADDON:NormalizeString(config.CollapseFiveMinuteAlarmSound, "ambient/alarms/klaxon1.wav")
config.CollapseTwoMinuteAlarmSound = "cutta_quest_system/music/resident evil 2 - escape alarm.mp3"
config.EscapePointDefaultModel = ADDON:NormalizeString(config.EscapePointDefaultModel, "models/props_phx/misc/bunker01.mdl")

function ADDON:NormalizeInteger(value, fallback, minimum, maximum)
local numeric = tonumber(value)

if not numeric then
return fallback
end

numeric = math.floor(numeric)

if minimum ~= nil and numeric < minimum then
if fallback ~= nil then
return fallback
end

numeric = minimum
end

if maximum ~= nil and numeric > maximum then
if fallback ~= nil then
return fallback
end

numeric = maximum
end

return numeric
end

function ADDON:NormalizeJobCommand(value)
if type(value) ~= "string" then return "" end
return string.lower(string.Trim(value))
end

function ADDON:NormalizeAssignmentKey(value)
return self:NormalizeJobCommand(value)
end

function ADDON:ParseTeamAssignmentKey(value)
local assignment_key = self:NormalizeAssignmentKey(value)

if string.sub(assignment_key, 1, 5) ~= "team:" then
return nil
end

local team_index = tonumber(string.sub(assignment_key, 6))

if not team_index or team_index <= 0 then
return nil
end

return math.floor(team_index)
end

function ADDON:BuildTeamAssignmentKey(team_index)
team_index = tonumber(team_index)

if not team_index or team_index <= 0 then
return ""
end

return "team:" .. math.floor(team_index)
end

function ADDON:GetTeamName(team_index, fallback)
team_index = tonumber(team_index)

if not team_index then
return fallback or ""
end

if team and team.GetName then
return self:NormalizeString(team.GetName(team_index) or "", fallback or "")
end

return fallback or ""
end

function ADDON:GetAssignmentType(command)
if self:ParseTeamAssignmentKey(command) then
return "team"
end

return "darkrp_job"
end

function ADDON:GetTeamAssignmentKey(team_index)
team_index = tonumber(team_index)

if not team_index or team_index <= 0 then
return ""
end

local job_table = self:GetJobTable(team_index)
local command = istable(job_table) and self:NormalizeJobCommand(job_table.command) or ""

if command ~= "" then
return command
end

return self:BuildTeamAssignmentKey(team_index)
end

function ADDON:NormalizeFactionKey(value)
local text = string.lower(self:NormalizeString(value, ""))

if text == "good" or text == "goodguys" or text == "good_guys" or text == "good guys" then
return "good"
end

if text == "bad" or text == "badguys" or text == "bad_guys" or text == "bad guys" then
return "bad"
end

return nil
end

function ADDON:NormalizeDelta(value, fallback)
fallback = self:NormalizeInteger(fallback, 0)

local numeric = self:NormalizeInteger(value, fallback)
if numeric == nil then
return fallback or 0
end

numeric = math.Clamp(numeric, self.Config.MinDelta, self.Config.MaxDelta)
return math.floor(numeric)
end

function ADDON:NormalizeMagnitude(value, fallback, maximum)
fallback = math.abs(self:NormalizeInteger(fallback, 0) or 0)

local numeric = self:NormalizeInteger(value, fallback)
if numeric == nil then
return fallback
end

numeric = math.abs(numeric)

if maximum ~= nil then
numeric = math.min(numeric, math.abs(tonumber(maximum) or numeric))
end

return math.floor(numeric)
end

function ADDON:NormalizeColorTable(value, fallback)
fallback = fallback or {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255, a = 255}

local red = math.Clamp(tonumber(value and (value.r or value[1])) or fallback.r or 255, 0, 255)
local green = math.Clamp(tonumber(value and (value.g or value[2])) or fallback.g or 255, 0, 255)
local blue = math.Clamp(tonumber(value and (value.b or value[3])) or fallback.b or 255, 0, 255)
local alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(value and (value.a or value[4])) or fallback.a or 255, 0, 255)

return {
r = red,
g = green,
b = blue,
a = alpha
}
end

function ADDON:ColorObject(value, fallback)
local color_table = self:NormalizeColorTable(value, fallback)
return Color(color_table.r, color_table.g, color_table.b, color_table.a)
end

for i=1,#nets do
local netstring = nets[i]
util.AddNetworkString(netstring)
end

net.Receive("CuttaCosmetic_Admin_SetPlayerCoins",function(l,ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:PlayerRank(ply) then return end
local targetsteamid = net.ReadString()
local newcoinamount = tonumber(net.ReadFloat()) or 0
local targetply = nil
for k,v in pairs(player.GetAll()) do
if v:SteamID() == targetsteamid then
targetply = v
break
end
end
if not IsValid(targetply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:COINS_SET(targetply,newcoinamount)
end)

net.Receive("CuttaCosmetic_Admin_SetPlayerPremiumCoins",function(l,ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:PlayerRank(ply) then return end

local targetsteamid = net.ReadString()
local newcoinamount = tonumber(net.ReadFloat()) or 0
local targetply = nil
for k,v in pairs(player.GetAll()) do
if v:SteamID() == targetsteamid then
targetply = v
break
end
end
if not IsValid(targetply) then return end
cutta_cosmetic_shop:PREMIUM_COINS_SET(targetply,newcoinamount)
end)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local nextAllowedAt = tonumber(ply.CuttaCosmetic_NextDarkRPMoneyExchangeAt or 0) or 0
local requestedCount = 1
if l >= 16 then
requestedCount = math.min(math.max(net.ReadUInt(16), 1), 65535)
end
local success = false
local message = "Please wait before converting again."

if CurTime() >= nextAllowedAt then
ply.CuttaCosmetic_NextDarkRPMoneyExchangeAt = CurTime() + 0.25
success, message = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertDarkRPMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
end

net.Start("CuttaCosmetic_Ply_ConvertDarkRPMoneyResult")
net.WriteBool(success == true)
net.WriteString(tostring(message or ""))
net.Send(ply)
end)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local nextAllowedAt = tonumber(ply.CuttaCosmetic_NextInventoryMoneyExchangeAt or 0) or 0
local requestedCount = 1
if l >= 16 then
requestedCount = math.min(math.max(net.ReadUInt(16), 1), 65535)
end
local success = false

if CurTime() >= nextAllowedAt then
ply.CuttaCosmetic_NextInventoryMoneyExchangeAt = CurTime() + 0.25

local function EnsureCoreTables()
local function NormalizeArrayLikeTable(tbl)
if not istable(tbl) then return {} end

if #tbl > 0 then
return tbl
end

local remapped = {}
local maxIndex = 0
local foundNumericKeys = false

for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
local numericKey = nil
if isnumber(key) then
numericKey = math.floor(key)
elseif isstring(key) then
numericKey = tonumber(key)
if numericKey ~= nil then
numericKey = math.floor(numericKey)
end
end

if numericKey ~= nil and numericKey >= 1 then
remapped[numericKey] = value
foundNumericKeys = true
if numericKey > maxIndex then
maxIndex = numericKey
end
end
end

if not foundNumericKeys then
return tbl
end

local normalized = {}
for index = 1, maxIndex do
if remapped[index] ~= nil then
normalized[#normalized + 1] = remapped[index]
end
end

return normalized
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeArrayTable = cutta_cosmetic_shop.NormalizeArrayTable or function(self, tbl)
return NormalizeArrayLikeTable(tbl)
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] or {})
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] or {})

cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] or {}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemBatchDepth"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemBatchDepth"] or 0

MoneyCost = 100000,
CoinReward = 100
}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["InventoryMoneyCoinExchange"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["InventoryMoneyCoinExchange"] or {
MoneyCost = 100000,
CoinReward = 100
}
cutta_cosmetic_shop["CoinsPremiumExchange"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop["CoinsPremiumExchange"] or {
CoinCost = 100000,
PremiumReward = 1
}
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizePriceCurrency(priceCurrency)
local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(tostring(priceCurrency or "")))
if normalized == "premium" or normalized == "premiumcoins" or normalized == "premium_coins" then
return "premium"
end

return "coins"
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetPriceCurrencyDisplayName(priceCurrency)
if self:NormalizePriceCurrency(priceCurrency) == "premium" then
return "Premium Coins"
end

return "Coins"
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:GetDarkRPMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
EnsureCoreTables()

local exchangeData = cutta_cosmetic_shop["DarkRPMoneyCoinExchange"] or {}
local moneyCost = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(exchangeData.MoneyCost) or 100000), 1)
local coinReward = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(exchangeData.CoinReward) or 100), 1)

cutta_cosmetic_shop["DarkRPMoneyCoinExchange"] = {

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if not isstring(modelPath) then return "" end

local normalized = string.Trim(modelPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

return normalized
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return "" end

local normalized = string.Trim(soundPath)
if normalized == "" then return "" end

normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "\\", "/")
normalized = string.lower(normalized)

while string.find(normalized, "//", 1, true) do
normalized = string.Replace(normalized, "//", "/")
end

while string.StartWith(normalized, "/") do
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 2)
end

if string.StartWith(normalized, "sound/") then
normalized = string.sub(normalized, 7)
end

return normalized
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ExtractWorkshopID(input)
if not isstring(input) then return nil end

local trimmed = string.Trim(input)
if trimmed == "" then return nil end

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")
if directId then
return directId
end

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")
if queryId then
return queryId
end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID)
workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")
if workshopID == "" then return "" end

return "https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=" .. workshopID
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(entries)
EnsureCoreTables()

local normalizedEntries = {}
local seenWorkshopIDs = {}
local normalizedInput = self:NormalizeArrayTable(entries or {})

for _, entry in ipairs(normalizedInput) do
if istable(entry) then
local rawLink = string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopLink or entry.Link or entry.link or ""))
local workshopID = tostring(entry.WorkshopID or entry.workshopid or self:ExtractWorkshopID(rawLink) or "")
local workshopTitle = string.Trim(tostring(entry.WorkshopTitle or entry.Title or entry.title or ""))

if workshopID ~= "" and not seenWorkshopIDs[workshopID] then
seenWorkshopIDs[workshopID] = true

local workshopLink = rawLink
if workshopLink == "" then
workshopLink = self:BuildWorkshopLink(workshopID)
end

normalizedEntries[#normalizedEntries + 1] = {
WorkshopID = workshopID,
WorkshopLink = workshopLink,
WorkshopTitle = workshopTitle ~= "" and workshopTitle or nil,
AutoMountOnJoin = entry.AutoMountOnJoin == true
or entry.AutoMount == true
or entry.automountonjoin == true
or entry.automount == true
}
end
end
end

table.sort(normalizedEntries, function(a, b)
local aTitle = string.lower(tostring(a.WorkshopTitle or a.WorkshopLink or a.WorkshopID or ""))
local bTitle = string.lower(tostring(b.WorkshopTitle or b.WorkshopLink or b.WorkshopID or ""))
if aTitle == bTitle then
return string.lower(tostring(a.WorkshopLink or a.WorkshopID or "")) < string.lower(tostring(b.WorkshopLink or b.WorkshopID or ""))
end

return aTitle < bTitle
end)

return normalizedEntries
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"] = self:NormalizeManualWorkshopLinkEntries(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Config"]["ManualWorkshopLinks"])

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:RebuildItemCaches()
EnsureCoreTables()

local items = self:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"])
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] = items
local itemIndex = {}
local categories = {}
local seenCategories = {}
local workshopModelIndex = {}

local function IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, modelPath)
local normalizedModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if normalizedModel == "" or workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] then return end

workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] = {
itemID = itemID,
workshopID = itemData.WorkshopID,
workshopLink = itemData.WorkshopLink,
modelPath = normalizedModel
}
end

local function ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(value)
if value == nil then return nil end
if value == true or value == 1 then return true end
if isstring(value) then
local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(value))
if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" then
return true
end
if normalized == "" or normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "nil" then
return nil
end
end
return nil
end

for index, itemData in ipairs(items) do
if istable(itemData) and itemData.ID then
local itemID = tostring(itemData.ID)
itemData.ID = itemID
itemIndex[itemID] = index

local category = itemData.Category or "Misc"
itemData.Category = category
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.Price) or 0), 0)
if tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) and tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) > 0 then
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) or 0), 0)
itemData.PriceCurrency = "premium"
itemData.PremiumPrice = nil
end
itemData.PriceCurrency = self:NormalizePriceCurrency(itemData.PriceCurrency)

if itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu ~= nil then
itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu = ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu)
end

if not seenCategories[category] then
seenCategories[category] = true
categories[#categories + 1] = category
end

if itemData.WorkshopID ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopID = tostring(itemData.WorkshopID)
if itemData.WorkshopID == "" then
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
end
end

if itemData.WorkshopLink ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.WorkshopLink))
if itemData.WorkshopLink == "" then
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
itemData.Sound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
elseif itemData.IsAnimation == "true" then
itemData.Animation = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.Animation or ""))
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
itemData.WorkshopAnimations = nil
end

if (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) and itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and itemData.IsAnimation ~= "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.Model)

if itemData.IsModel == "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.HandsModel)
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
if (not istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) or #itemData.WorkshopSounds == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopSounds = {}
local normalizedItemSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
if normalizedItemSound ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopSounds[#fallbackWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedItemSound
end
if #fallbackWorkshopSounds > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopSounds = fallbackWorkshopSounds
end
end

if istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) then
local sanitizedWorkshopSounds = {}
local seenWorkshopSounds = {}
for _, workshopSound in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopSounds) do
local normalizedWorkshopSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(workshopSound)
if normalizedWorkshopSound ~= "" and not seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] then
seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] = true
sanitizedWorkshopSounds[#sanitizedWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedWorkshopSound
end
end
itemData.WorkshopSounds = sanitizedWorkshopSounds
end
elseif (not istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) or #itemData.WorkshopModels == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopModels = {}
local normalizedItemModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.Model)
if normalizedItemModel ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedItemModel
end
local normalizedHandsModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.HandsModel)
if normalizedHandsModel ~= "" and normalizedHandsModel ~= normalizedItemModel then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedHandsModel
end
if #fallbackWorkshopModels > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopModels = fallbackWorkshopModels
end
end

if itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) then
local sanitizedWorkshopModels = {}
local seenWorkshopModels = {}
for _, workshopModel in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopModels) do
local normalizedWorkshopModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(workshopModel)
if normalizedWorkshopModel ~= "" and not seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] then
seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] = true
sanitizedWorkshopModels[#sanitizedWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedWorkshopModel
end
end
itemData.WorkshopModels = sanitizedWorkshopModels
end
end
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] = itemIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] = categories
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_WorkshopModelIndex"] = workshopModelIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemCachesReady"] = true

return itemIndex, categories
end

-- Returns true if the player's usergroup is permitted for this item.
-- Accepts either `item.RequiredUserGroups` (table of strings) or legacy `item.RequiredUserGroup` (single string).
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Item_UserGroupAllowed(ply, cosmeticid)
if not IsValid(ply) or not cosmeticid then return true end
local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)
if not item then return true end
local plyGroup = string.lower(ply:GetUserGroup() or "")

-- Gather required groups into a flat table of lowercase strings
local required = {}

-- If server stored a table already
if istable(item.RequiredUserGroups) then
for _, g in ipairs(item.RequiredUserGroups) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
end

-- Legacy single string field
if isstring(item.RequiredUserGroup) and item.RequiredUserGroup ~= "" then
local s = item.RequiredUserGroup
-- If it contains commas, treat as multi-list
if s:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in s:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
else
table.insert(required, string.lower(s))
end
end

-- If original creation sent a JSON string and was not parsed server-side
if #required == 0 and isstring(item.RequiredUserGroups) and item.RequiredUserGroups ~= "" then
local raw = item.RequiredUserGroups
local ok, parsed = pcall(util.JSONToTable, raw)
if ok and istable(parsed) then
for _, g in ipairs(parsed) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
elseif raw:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in raw:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
elseif raw ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(raw))
end
end

-- No restriction specified
if #required == 0 then return true end

for _, g in ipairs(required) do
if plyGroup == g then
return true
end
end
return false
end

info.posz = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posz) or 0, -300, 300)
info.pitch = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.pitch) or 0, -180, 180)
info.yaw = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.yaw) or 0, -180, 180)
info.roll = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.roll) or 0, -180, 180)

-- do nothing
end
end

out[cosmeticid] = info
end

return out
end

if not istable(tbl) then return {} end

if #tbl > 0 then
return tbl
end

local remapped = {}
local maxIndex = 0
local foundNumericKeys = false

for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
local numericKey = nil
if isnumber(key) then
numericKey = math.floor(key)
elseif isstring(key) then
numericKey = tonumber(key)
if numericKey ~= nil then
numericKey = math.floor(numericKey)
end
end

if numericKey ~= nil and numericKey >= 1 then

foundNumericKeys = true
if numericKey > maxIndex then
maxIndex = numericKey
end
end
end

if not foundNumericKeys then
return tbl
end

local normalized = {}
for index = 1, maxIndex do
if remapped[index] ~= nil then
normalized[#normalized + 1] = remapped[index]
end
end

return normalized
end

if not item or item.IsSound ~= "true" then return false end

if self:NormalizeSoundPath(item.Sound) == normalizedSound then
return true
end

if istable(item.WorkshopSounds) then
for _, workshopSound in ipairs(item.WorkshopSounds) do

end

return false

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:RebuildItemCaches()
EnsureCoreTables()

local items = self:NormalizeArrayTable(cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"])
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Items"] = items
local itemIndex = {}
local categories = {}
local seenCategories = {}
local workshopModelIndex = {}

local function IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, modelPath)
local normalizedModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(modelPath)
if normalizedModel == "" or workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] then return end

workshopModelIndex[normalizedModel] = {
itemID = itemID,
workshopID = itemData.WorkshopID,
workshopLink = itemData.WorkshopLink,
modelPath = normalizedModel
}
end

local function ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(value)
if value == nil then return nil end
if value == true or value == 1 then return true end
if isstring(value) then
local normalized = string.lower(string.Trim(value))
if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" then
return true
end
if normalized == "" or normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "nil" then
return nil
end
end
return nil
end

for index, itemData in ipairs(items) do
if istable(itemData) and itemData.ID then
local itemID = tostring(itemData.ID)
itemData.ID = itemID
itemIndex[itemID] = index

local category = itemData.Category or "Misc"
itemData.Category = category
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.Price) or 0), 0)
if tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) and tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) > 0 then
itemData.Price = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(itemData.PremiumPrice) or 0), 0)
itemData.PriceCurrency = "premium"
itemData.PremiumPrice = nil
end
itemData.PriceCurrency = self:NormalizePriceCurrency(itemData.PriceCurrency)

if itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu ~= nil then
itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu = ParseHiddenInCosmeticsMenu(itemData.HideInCosmeticsMenu)
end

if not seenCategories[category] then
seenCategories[category] = true
categories[#categories + 1] = category
end

if itemData.WorkshopID ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopID = tostring(itemData.WorkshopID)
if itemData.WorkshopID == "" then
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
end
end

if itemData.WorkshopLink ~= nil then
itemData.WorkshopLink = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.WorkshopLink))
if itemData.WorkshopLink == "" then
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
itemData.Sound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
elseif itemData.IsAnimation == "true" then
itemData.Animation = string.Trim(tostring(itemData.Animation or ""))
itemData.WorkshopID = nil
itemData.WorkshopLink = nil
itemData.WorkshopAnimations = nil
end

if (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) and itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and itemData.IsAnimation ~= "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.Model)

if itemData.IsModel == "true" then
IndexWorkshopLinkedModel(itemID, itemData, itemData.HandsModel)
end
end

if itemData.IsSound == "true" then
if (not istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) or #itemData.WorkshopSounds == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopSounds = {}
local normalizedItemSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(itemData.Sound)
if normalizedItemSound ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopSounds[#fallbackWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedItemSound
end
if #fallbackWorkshopSounds > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopSounds = fallbackWorkshopSounds
end
end

if istable(itemData.WorkshopSounds) then
local sanitizedWorkshopSounds = {}
local seenWorkshopSounds = {}
for _, workshopSound in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopSounds) do
local normalizedWorkshopSound = self:NormalizeSoundPath(workshopSound)
if normalizedWorkshopSound ~= "" and not seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] then
seenWorkshopSounds[normalizedWorkshopSound] = true
sanitizedWorkshopSounds[#sanitizedWorkshopSounds + 1] = normalizedWorkshopSound
end
end
itemData.WorkshopSounds = sanitizedWorkshopSounds
end
elseif (not istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) or #itemData.WorkshopModels == 0) and (itemData.WorkshopID or itemData.WorkshopLink) then
local fallbackWorkshopModels = {}
local normalizedItemModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.Model)
if normalizedItemModel ~= "" then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedItemModel
end
local normalizedHandsModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(itemData.HandsModel)
if normalizedHandsModel ~= "" and normalizedHandsModel ~= normalizedItemModel then
fallbackWorkshopModels[#fallbackWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedHandsModel
end
if #fallbackWorkshopModels > 0 then
itemData.WorkshopModels = fallbackWorkshopModels
end
end

if itemData.IsSound ~= "true" and istable(itemData.WorkshopModels) then
local sanitizedWorkshopModels = {}
local seenWorkshopModels = {}
for _, workshopModel in ipairs(itemData.WorkshopModels) do
local normalizedWorkshopModel = self:NormalizeModelPath(workshopModel)
if normalizedWorkshopModel ~= "" and not seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] then
seenWorkshopModels[normalizedWorkshopModel] = true
sanitizedWorkshopModels[#sanitizedWorkshopModels + 1] = normalizedWorkshopModel
end
end
itemData.WorkshopModels = sanitizedWorkshopModels
end
end
end

cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemIndex"] = itemIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["Categories"] = categories
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_WorkshopModelIndex"] = workshopModelIndex
cutta_cosmetic_shop["_ItemCachesReady"] = true

return itemIndex, categories
end

-- Returns true if the player's usergroup is permitted for this item.
-- Accepts either `item.RequiredUserGroups` (table of strings) or legacy `item.RequiredUserGroup` (single string).
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Item_UserGroupAllowed(ply, cosmeticid)
if not IsValid(ply) or not cosmeticid then return true end
local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)
if not item then return true end
local plyGroup = string.lower(ply:GetUserGroup() or "")

-- Gather required groups into a flat table of lowercase strings
local required = {}

-- If server stored a table already
if istable(item.RequiredUserGroups) then
for _, g in ipairs(item.RequiredUserGroups) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
end

-- Legacy single string field
if isstring(item.RequiredUserGroup) and item.RequiredUserGroup ~= "" then
local s = item.RequiredUserGroup
-- If it contains commas, treat as multi-list
if s:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in s:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
else
table.insert(required, string.lower(s))
end
end

-- If original creation sent a JSON string and was not parsed server-side
if #required == 0 and isstring(item.RequiredUserGroups) and item.RequiredUserGroups ~= "" then
local raw = item.RequiredUserGroups
local ok, parsed = pcall(util.JSONToTable, raw)
if ok and istable(parsed) then
for _, g in ipairs(parsed) do
if isstring(g) and g ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(g))
end
end
elseif raw:find(",", 1, true) then
for token in raw:gmatch("[^,]+") do
local trimmed = string.Trim(token)
if trimmed ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(trimmed))
end
end
elseif raw ~= "" then
table.insert(required, string.lower(raw))
end
end

-- No restriction specified
if #required == 0 then return true end

for _, g in ipairs(required) do
if plyGroup == g then
return true
end
end
return false
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_USERGROUP_CHECK(cosmeticid)
local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)

return true
end
return false
end

local function boolFromValue(value, defaultValue)
if value == nil then return defaultValue == true end
if value == true or value == 1 then return true end

if isstring(value) then

if normalized == "true" or normalized == "1" or normalized == "yes" then
return true
end

if normalized == "false" or normalized == "0" or normalized == "no" or normalized == "" then
return false
end
end

return defaultValue == true
end

-- Shared helper: cosmetic attachment scaling (props/pets only)
-- Max is always 1 (original size). Only allow smaller.
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(scale)
local s = tonumber(scale)
if not s then return 1 end
-- allow very small, but avoid negative / NaN / huge values
if s ~= s then return 1 end
return math.Clamp(s, 0.05, 1)
end

-- Server-side helper: sanitize character prop table coming from disk/client
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:SanitizeCharacterPropsTable(ply, tbl)
if not IsValid(ply) or not istable(tbl) then return {} end

local out = {}
for rawId, rawInfo in pairs(tbl) do
local cosmeticid = tostring(rawId or "")
if cosmeticid == "" then continue end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_VALID(cosmeticid) then continue end
if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:PLY_ITEM_CHECK(ply, cosmeticid) then continue end

local itemType = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_TYPE_CHECK(cosmeticid)
if itemType ~= "IsProp" and itemType ~= "IsPet" then
continue
end

if not istable(rawInfo) then continue end
local added = rawInfo.added == true or rawInfo.added == "true"
if not added then
continue
end

local info = {}
info.added = true
info.model = tostring(rawInfo.model or cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_MODEL_GET(cosmeticid) or "")
info.cosmetic_id = cosmeticid
info.boneselect = tostring(rawInfo.boneselect or "ValveBiped.Bip01_Head1")

info.posx = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posx) or 0, -300, 300)
info.posy = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posy) or 0, -300, 300)
info.posz = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.posz) or 0, -300, 300)
info.pitch = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.pitch) or 0, -180, 180)
info.yaw = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.yaw) or 0, -180, 180)
info.roll = math.Clamp(tonumber(rawInfo.roll) or 0, -180, 180)

info.scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(rawInfo.scale)

if itemType == "IsPet" then
local defaultAnim = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_PETANIM_CHECK(cosmeticid)
info.petanimation = tostring(rawInfo.petanimation or defaultAnim or "idle")
else
-- keep field absent for props (cleaner saves)
if rawInfo.petanimation ~= nil then
-- do nothing
end
end

out[cosmeticid] = info
end

return out
end

question: Show a safe pattern for fetching JSON data in a Garry's Mod addon.
answer:
```lua
http.Fetch("https://example.com/myaddon/config.json",
function(body)
local data = util.JSONToTable(body)
if not istable(data) then
ErrorNoHalt("[MyAddon] Invalid JSON response
")
return
end

print("Fetched config version:", data.version)
end,
function(err)
ErrorNoHalt("[MyAddon] HTTP failed: " .. tostring(err) .. "
")
end)
```

Treat remote data as untrusted input. Validate shape and types before you use it in gameplay code.

question: Write the Garry's Mod addon file "cutta_inventory_system/lua/cutta_inventory_system/cl_loot_crate.lua".
answer:
local function CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateGridSize"] or 4) or 4), 1)

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()

local gridSize = CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

return gridSize * gridSize

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateUseDistance()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateUseDistance"] or 120) or 120), 48)

end

local function CIS_GetLootCratePlayerLayout()

local ply = LocalPlayer()
local data = IsValid(ply) and ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] or {}

return data["InventoryLayout"] or data["Inventory"] or {}

end

local function CIS_LootCratePanelContainsPoint(panel, x, y)

if not IsValid(panel) then return false end

local panelX, panelY = panel:LocalToScreen(0, 0)

return x >= panelX and y >= panelY and x <= (panelX + panel:GetWide()) and y <= (panelY + panel:GetTall())

end

local function CIS_ClearPanelChildren(panel)

if not IsValid(panel) then return end

for _, child in ipairs(panel:GetChildren() or {}) do

if IsValid(child) then

child:Remove()

end

end

end

local function CIS_CreateLootCrateDragGhost(frame, itemData, itemAmount)

local ghost = vgui.Create("DPanel", frame)
ghost:SetSize(96, 96)
ghost:SetMouseInputEnabled(false)
ghost:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(false)
ghost:SetAlpha(235)
ghost:SetDrawOnTop(true)
ghost:SetZPos(32767)
ghost:MoveToFront()

ghost.Paint = function(pan, w, h)

pan.CIS_State = "occupied"
pan.CIS_Label = string.upper(string.Left(itemData.Name or itemData.Class or "ITEM", 12))
pan.CIS_StackAmount = itemAmount

cutta_inventory_system:Paint_RESlot(pan, w, h)

if (itemAmount or 0) > 1 then

draw.SimpleText("x" .. tostring(itemAmount), "cis_re_small", w - 8, h - 10, color_white, TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_BOTTOM)

end

end

local modelPanel = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", ghost)
modelPanel:SetPos(8, 8)
modelPanel:SetSize(80, 60)
modelPanel:SetMouseInputEnabled(false)
cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(modelPanel, itemData.Model, 0.8)

frame.CIS_LootCrateDragGhost = ghost

return ghost

end

local function CIS_ClearLootCratePendingPress(frame)

local pressState = frame.CIS_LootCratePendingPress

if pressState and IsValid(pressState.Button) then

pressState.Button:MouseCapture(false)

end

frame.CIS_LootCratePendingPress = nil

end

local function CIS_StopLootCrateDrag(frame)

if IsValid(frame.CIS_LootCrateDragGhost) then

frame.CIS_LootCrateDragGhost:Remove()

end

frame.CIS_LootCrateDragGhost = nil
frame.CIS_LootCrateDragState = nil

end

local function CIS_RegisterLootCrateClick(frame, slotIndex)

if not IsValid(frame) then return end
if not cutta_inventory_system:Player_CanClick() then return end

local lastClick = frame.CIS_LastLootCrateClick or {}
local now = CurTime()

if lastClick.SlotIndex == slotIndex and (now - (lastClick.Time or 0)) <= 0.3 then

surface.PlaySound("select_re2.mp3")
cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_MoveToInventory(frame.CIS_EntIndex, frame.CIS_SecurityCode, slotIndex, 0)
frame.CIS_LastLootCrateClick = nil

return

end

frame.CIS_LastLootCrateClick = {

SlotIndex = slotIndex,

Time = now,

}

end

local function CIS_StartLootCrateDrag(frame, slotIndex, itemData, itemAmount)

if not IsValid(frame) then return end
if frame.CIS_LootCrateDragState then return end

frame.CIS_LootCrateDragState = {

SlotIndex = slotIndex,

ItemData = itemData,

Amount = itemAmount,

}

CIS_CreateLootCrateDragGhost(frame, itemData, itemAmount)

end

local function CIS_FinishLootCrateDrag(frame)

local dragState = frame.CIS_LootCrateDragState

if not dragState then return end

local mouseX, mouseY = gui.MousePos()

if CIS_LootCratePanelContainsPoint(frame.CIS_PlayerInventoryShell, mouseX, mouseY) then

local targetIndex = 0

for slotIndex, panel in pairs(frame.CIS_PlayerSlotPanels or {}) do

if IsValid(panel) and panel.CIS_Unlocked and CIS_LootCratePanelContainsPoint(panel, mouseX, mouseY) then

targetIndex = slotIndex
break

end

end

surface.PlaySound("select_re2.mp3")
cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_MoveToInventory(frame.CIS_EntIndex, frame.CIS_SecurityCode, dragState.SlotIndex, targetIndex)

end

CIS_StopLootCrateDrag(frame)

end

local function CIS_ConfigureLootCratePlayerSlot(frame, slot, index, unlockedSlots)

local theme = cutta_inventory_system:Get_RETheme()
local inventoryTable = CIS_GetLootCratePlayerLayout()
local slotData = inventoryTable[index]
local itemClass = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slotData)
local itemAmount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slotData)
local itemData = itemClass and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][itemClass] or nil

CIS_ClearPanelChildren(slot)

slot.CIS_State = "empty"
slot.CIS_Label = "EMPTY"
slot.CIS_StackAmount = 0
slot.CIS_Unlocked = index <= unlockedSlots

if itemData then

slot.CIS_State = "occupied"
slot.CIS_Label = string.upper(string.Left(itemData.Name or itemData.Class or "ITEM", 12))
slot.CIS_StackAmount = itemAmount

local modelPanel = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", slot)
modelPanel:SetPos(8, 8)
modelPanel:SetSize(80, 60)
modelPanel:SetMouseInputEnabled(false)
cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(modelPanel, itemData.Model, 0.8)

local overlay = vgui.Create("DButton", slot)
overlay:Dock(FILL)
overlay:SetText("")
overlay.Paint = nil
overlay.OnCursorEntered = function()

cutta_inventory_system:Set_REHoverText(frame, itemData.Name .. " x" .. tostring(itemAmount))

end

elseif index > unlockedSlots then

slot.CIS_State = "locked"
slot.CIS_Label = "LOCKED"

local overlay = vgui.Create("DButton", slot)
overlay:Dock(FILL)
overlay:SetText("")
overlay.Paint = nil
overlay.OnCursorEntered = function()

cutta_inventory_system:Set_REHoverText(frame, "Locked inventory slot")

end

else

local overlay = vgui.Create("DButton", slot)
overlay:Dock(FILL)
overlay:SetText("")
overlay.Paint = nil
overlay.OnCursorEntered = function()

cutta_inventory_system:Set_REHoverText(frame, "Drop loot here")

end

end

slot.Paint = function(pan, w, h)

cutta_inventory_system:Paint_RESlot(pan, w, h)

if (pan.CIS_StackAmount or 0) > 1 then

draw.SimpleText("x" .. tostring(pan.CIS_StackAmount), "cis_re_small", w - 8, h - 10, theme.text, TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_BOTTOM)

end

end

end

local function CIS_ConfigureLootCrateSlot(frame, slot, index)

local theme = cutta_inventory_system:Get_RETheme()
local slotData = frame.CIS_LootCrateInventory[index]
local itemClass = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slotData)
local itemAmount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slotData)
local itemData = itemClass and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][itemClass] or nil

CIS_ClearPanelChildren(slot)

slot.CIS_State = "empty"
slot.CIS_Label = "EMPTY"
slot.CIS_StackAmount = 0
slot.CIS_Unlocked = true

if itemData then

slot.CIS_State = "occupied"
slot.CIS_Label = string.upper(string.Left(itemData.Name or itemData.Class or "ITEM", 12))
slot.CIS_StackAmount = itemAmount

local modelPanel = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", slot)
modelPanel:SetPos(8, 8)
modelPanel:SetSize(80, 60)
modelPanel:SetMouseInputEnabled(false)
cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(modelPanel, itemData.Model, 0.8)

local overlay = vgui.Create("DButton", slot)
overlay:Dock(FILL)
overlay:SetText("")
overlay.Paint = nil
overlay:SetCursor("sizeall")
overlay.OnMousePressed = function(btn, mouseCode)

if mouseCode != MOUSE_LEFT then return end
if not cutta_inventory_system:Player_CanClick() then return end

local mouseX, mouseY = gui.MousePos()

frame.CIS_LootCratePendingPress = {

SlotIndex = index,

ItemData = itemData,

Amount = itemAmount,

StartX = mouseX,

StartY = mouseY,

Button = btn,

}

btn:MouseCapture(true)

end
overlay.OnMouseReleased = function(btn, mouseCode)

if mouseCode != MOUSE_LEFT then return end

btn:MouseCapture(false)

if frame.CIS_LootCrateDragState then

CIS_FinishLootCrateDrag(frame)

return

end

if frame.CIS_LootCratePendingPress and frame.CIS_LootCratePendingPress.SlotIndex == index then

CIS_ClearLootCratePendingPress(frame)
CIS_RegisterLootCrateClick(frame, index)

return

end

CIS_ClearLootCratePendingPress(frame)

end
overlay.OnCursorEntered = function()

cutta_inventory_system:Set_REHoverText(frame, itemData.Name .. " x" .. tostring(itemAmount) .. " | Double click to loot, drag to inventory")

end

else

local overlay = vgui.Create("DButton", slot)
overlay:Dock(FILL)
overlay:SetText("")
overlay.Paint = nil
overlay.OnCursorEntered = function()

cutta_inventory_system:Set_REHoverText(frame, "Empty loot slot")

end

end

slot.Paint = function(pan, w, h)

cutta_inventory_system:Paint_RESlot(pan, w, h)

if (pan.CIS_StackAmount or 0) > 1 then

draw.SimpleText("x" .. tostring(pan.CIS_StackAmount), "cis_re_small", w - 8, h - 10, theme.text, TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, TEXT_ALIGN_BOTTOM)

end

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_MoveToInventory(entIndex, securityCode, fromIndex, targetIndex)

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."LootCrate_MoveToInventory")
net.WriteInt(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(entIndex) or 0), 0), 32)

net.WriteInt(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(fromIndex) or 0), 0), 12)

local function CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()

local gridSize = CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

return gridSize * gridSize

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateUseDistance()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateUseDistance"] or 120) or 120), 48)

local function CIS_GetLootCratePlayerLayout()

local ply = LocalPlayer()
local data = IsValid(ply) and ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] or {}

return data["InventoryLayout"] or data["Inventory"] or {}

end

local function CIS_LootCratePanelContainsPoint(panel, x, y)

if not IsValid(panel) then return false end

local panelX, panelY = panel:LocalToScreen(0, 0)

return x >= panelX and y >= panelY and x <= (panelX + panel:GetWide()) and y <= (panelY + panel:GetTall())

end

local function CIS_ClearPanelChildren(panel)

if not IsValid(panel) then return end

for _, child in ipairs(panel:GetChildren() or {}) do

end

end

local CUTTAQS_COLOR_RED = Color(190,60,50)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL = Color(10,14,20)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL_SOFT = Color(17,22,30)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER = Color(255,255,255,18)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT = Color(236,240,244)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT_SOFT = Color(171,180,191)
local CUTTAQS_COLOR_BLUE = Color(78,132,204)

local CUTTAQS_ICON_USER = Material("icon16/user.png", "smooth")
local CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_SHOW_TIME = 4
local CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_HIDE_TIME = 10

local CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM = {
infoSignature = "",
infoChangedAt = 0,
dialogueSignature = "",
dialogueChangedAt = 0,
cutsceneBarHeight = 0,
railNextY = 0,
gatherAlpha = 0,
questAlpha = 0,

questCycleChangedAt = 0,

questCycleAlpha = 1,
gatherCycleState = "visible",
gatherCycleChangedAt = 0,
gatherCycleSignature = "",
gatherCycleAlpha = 1
}

local function CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(current, target, speed)
return Lerp(math.Clamp(FrameTime() * (speed or 10), 0, 1), current, target)
end

local function CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
local alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(alphaMultiplier) or 1, 0, 1)
return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * alpha))
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
surface.SetFont(font)
local _, textH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
return textH
end

local function CUTTAQS_WrapText(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then
text = tostring(text or "")
end

text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then
return {}, CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineHeight = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then
return { text }, lineHeight
end

maxLines = tonumber(maxLines) or 99
if maxLines < 1 then maxLines = 1 end

local lines = {}
local currentLine = ""

local function pushLine(lineText)
lineText = string.Trim(lineText or "")
if lineText == "" then return end
table.insert(lines, lineText)
end

local function fits(lineText)
local textW = surface.GetTextSize(lineText)
return textW <= maxWidth
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local candidate = currentLine == "" and word or (currentLine .. " " .. word)
if fits(candidate) then
currentLine = candidate
else
pushLine(currentLine)
currentLine = word
if #lines >= maxLines then
break
end
end
end

if #lines < maxLines then
pushLine(currentLine)
end

if #lines > maxLines then
while #lines > maxLines do
table.remove(lines)
end
end

if #lines == maxLines and currentLine ~= "" and not fits(currentLine) then
lines[#lines] = string.sub(lines[#lines], 1, math.max(1, #lines[#lines] - 3)) .. "..."
end

return lines, lineHeight
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, alignX, alignY)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return end
draw.SimpleText(text, font, x, y, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier), alignX or TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, alignY or TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x, y, size, thickness, colorValue)
draw.RoundedBox(0, x, y, size, thickness, colorValue)
draw.RoundedBox(0, x, y, thickness, size, colorValue)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawPanelChrome(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
local lineAlpha = (0.08 + pulse * 0.04) * alpha
local shimmerW = math.max(26, math.floor(width * 0.14))
local shimmerX = x + 18 + (((CurTime() * 34) % (width + shimmerW)) - shimmerW)

draw.RoundedBox(0, shimmerX, y + 12, shimmerW, height - 24, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,6), alpha))

for row = y + 16, y + height - 16, 8 do
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, row, width - 36, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,10), lineAlpha))
end

local bracketColor = CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.46 + pulse * 0.16) * alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + 12, y + 12, 14, 2, bracketColor)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + width - 26, y + height - 26, 14, 2, bracketColor)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + 18, 52, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + width - 70, y + height - 18, 52, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha))
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(x, y, colorValue, alpha, pulse)
local size = 6 + pulse * 2
draw.RoundedBox(8, x, y, size, size, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(8, x - 2, y - 2, size + 4, size + 4, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, 35), alpha * 0.45))
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetHudRailAnchor()
local railX = math.max(14, ScrW() * 0.022)
local railY = math.max(18, (ScrH() * 0.5) - math.min(132, ScrH() * 0.16))
return railX, railY
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
if alpha <= 0 then return end

pulse = tonumber(pulse) or 0
local shadowOffset = 10
local cardX = x
local cardY = y

draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + shadowOffset, cardY + shadowOffset, width, height, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(84 * alpha)))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX, cardY, width, height, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL, 0.86 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 1, cardY + 1, width - 2, height - 2, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL_SOFT, 0.58 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 8, cardY + 8, width - 16, height - 16, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(6,9,13,160), 0.45 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX, cardY, 4, height, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.78 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX + 18, cardY + height - 3, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.18 + pulse * 0.12) * alpha))
surface.SetDrawColor(CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha * 0.7))
surface.DrawOutlinedRect(cardX, cardY, width, height, 1)
CUTTAQS_DrawPanelChrome(cardX, cardY, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawToast(y, text, remaining, accentColor, headerText)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return 0 end

remaining = math.max(tonumber(remaining) or 0, 0)
local totalDuration = 5
local progress = math.Clamp(1 - (remaining / totalDuration), 0, 1)
local fadeIn = math.Clamp(progress / 0.16, 0, 1)
local fadeOut = math.Clamp(remaining / 0.75, 0, 1)
local alpha = fadeIn * fadeOut
if alpha <= 0 then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 7) + 1) * 0.5
local railX = CUTTAQS_GetHudRailAnchor()
local width = math.min(288, ScrW() * 0.215)
local height = 44
local x = railX - (1 - fadeIn) * 30

CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(x + 18, y + 12, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(headerText or "QUEST UPDATE", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", x + 30, y + 9, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.95), alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", x + 18, y + 21, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,26), alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, (width - 36) * math.Clamp(remaining / totalDuration, 0, 1), 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, alpha))
return height + 8
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(lines, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, lineGap)
local textY = y
local textHeight = CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
lineGap = tonumber(lineGap) or 4

for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(line, font, x, textY, colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
textY = textY + textHeight + lineGap
end

return textY
end

local function CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(text, font, maxWidth)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return "" end

surface.SetFont(font)
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text)) <= maxWidth then
return text
end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) * 0.5)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate)) <= maxWidth then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end

return string.sub(text, 1, math.max(1, low)) .. ellipsis
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetCutsceneDialogueLayout(text, maxWidth, maxHeight)
local candidateFonts = {
"cuttaqs_tothepoint",
"cuttaqs_cutscene_text",
"cuttaqs_bankgothic",
"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

local function CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(current, target, speed)
return Lerp(math.Clamp(FrameTime() * (speed or 10), 0, 1), current, target)
end

local function CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
local alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(alphaMultiplier) or 1, 0, 1)
return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * alpha))
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
surface.SetFont(font)
local _, textH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
return textH
end

local function CUTTAQS_WrapText(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then
text = tostring(text or "")
end

text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then
return {}, CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineHeight = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then
return { text }, lineHeight
end

maxLines = tonumber(maxLines) or 99
if maxLines < 1 then maxLines = 1 end

local lines = {}
local currentLine = ""

local function pushLine(lineText)
lineText = string.Trim(lineText or "")
if lineText == "" then return end
table.insert(lines, lineText)
end

local function fits(lineText)
local textW = surface.GetTextSize(lineText)
return textW <= maxWidth
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local candidate = currentLine == "" and word or (currentLine .. " " .. word)
if fits(candidate) then
currentLine = candidate
else
pushLine(currentLine)
currentLine = word
if #lines >= maxLines then
break
end
end
end

if #lines < maxLines then
pushLine(currentLine)
end

if #lines > maxLines then
while #lines > maxLines do
table.remove(lines)
end
end

if #lines == maxLines and currentLine ~= "" and not fits(currentLine) then
lines[#lines] = string.sub(lines[#lines], 1, math.max(1, #lines[#lines] - 3)) .. "..."
end

return lines, lineHeight
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, alignX, alignY)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return end
draw.SimpleText(text, font, x, y, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alphaMultiplier), alignX or TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, alignY or TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x, y, size, thickness, colorValue)
draw.RoundedBox(0, x, y, size, thickness, colorValue)
draw.RoundedBox(0, x, y, thickness, size, colorValue)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawPanelChrome(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
local lineAlpha = (0.08 + pulse * 0.04) * alpha
local shimmerW = math.max(26, math.floor(width * 0.14))
local shimmerX = x + 18 + (((CurTime() * 34) % (width + shimmerW)) - shimmerW)

draw.RoundedBox(0, shimmerX, y + 12, shimmerW, height - 24, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,6), alpha))

for row = y + 16, y + height - 16, 8 do
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, row, width - 36, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,10), lineAlpha))
end

local bracketColor = CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.46 + pulse * 0.16) * alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + 12, y + 12, 14, 2, bracketColor)
CUTTAQS_DrawCornerBracket(x + width - 26, y + height - 26, 14, 2, bracketColor)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + 18, 52, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + width - 70, y + height - 18, 52, 1, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha))
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(x, y, colorValue, alpha, pulse)
local size = 6 + pulse * 2
draw.RoundedBox(8, x, y, size, size, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(8, x - 2, y - 2, size + 4, size + 4, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, 35), alpha * 0.45))
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetHudRailAnchor()
local railX = math.max(14, ScrW() * 0.022)
local railY = math.max(18, (ScrH() * 0.5) - math.min(132, ScrH() * 0.16))
return railX, railY
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
if alpha <= 0 then return end

pulse = tonumber(pulse) or 0
local shadowOffset = 10
local cardX = x
local cardY = y

draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + shadowOffset, cardY + shadowOffset, width, height, Color(0, 0, 0, math.floor(84 * alpha)))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX, cardY, width, height, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL, 0.86 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 1, cardY + 1, width - 2, height - 2, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_PANEL_SOFT, 0.58 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(14, cardX + 8, cardY + 8, width - 16, height - 16, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(6,9,13,160), 0.45 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX, cardY, 4, height, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.78 * alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, cardX + 18, cardY + height - 3, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, (0.18 + pulse * 0.12) * alpha))
surface.SetDrawColor(CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BORDER, alpha * 0.7))
surface.DrawOutlinedRect(cardX, cardY, width, height, 1)
CUTTAQS_DrawPanelChrome(cardX, cardY, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawToast(y, text, remaining, accentColor, headerText)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return 0 end

remaining = math.max(tonumber(remaining) or 0, 0)
local totalDuration = 5
local progress = math.Clamp(1 - (remaining / totalDuration), 0, 1)
local fadeIn = math.Clamp(progress / 0.16, 0, 1)
local fadeOut = math.Clamp(remaining / 0.75, 0, 1)
local alpha = fadeIn * fadeOut
if alpha <= 0 then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 7) + 1) * 0.5
local railX = CUTTAQS_GetHudRailAnchor()
local width = math.min(288, ScrW() * 0.215)
local height = 44
local x = railX - (1 - fadeIn) * 30

CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(x, y, width, height, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(x + 18, y + 12, accentColor, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(headerText or "QUEST UPDATE", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", x + 30, y + 9, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, 0.95), alpha)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(text, "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", x + 18, y + 21, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha)

draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, width - 36, 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(Color(255,255,255,26), alpha))
draw.RoundedBox(0, x + 18, y + height - 10, (width - 36) * math.Clamp(remaining / totalDuration, 0, 1), 3, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(accentColor, alpha))
return height + 8
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(lines, font, x, y, colorValue, alphaMultiplier, lineGap)
local textY = y
local textHeight = CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(font)
lineGap = tonumber(lineGap) or 4

for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(line, font, x, textY, colorValue, alphaMultiplier)
textY = textY + textHeight + lineGap
end

return textY
end

local function CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(text, font, maxWidth)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if text == "" then return "" end

surface.SetFont(font)
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text)) <= maxWidth then
return text
end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) * 0.5)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
if select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate)) <= maxWidth then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end

return string.sub(text, 1, math.max(1, low)) .. ellipsis
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetCutsceneDialogueLayout(text, maxWidth, maxHeight)
local candidateFonts = {
"cuttaqs_tothepoint",
"cuttaqs_cutscene_text",
"cuttaqs_bankgothic",
"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",
"cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini"
}

local bestLayout = nil
local compactGap = 4
local textStr = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
if textStr == "" then return nil end

maxWidth = math.max(140, tonumber(maxWidth) or 140)
maxHeight = math.max(18, tonumber(maxHeight) or 18)

for _, fontName in ipairs(candidateFonts) do
local lineHeight = CUTTAQS_GetTextHeight(fontName)
local maxLines = math.max(1, math.floor((maxHeight + compactGap) / (lineHeight + compactGap)))
local lines = select(1, CUTTAQS_WrapText(textStr, fontName, maxWidth, maxLines))

if #lines > 0 then
local joinedLength = string.len(table.concat(lines, " "))
if #lines >= maxLines and joinedLength < string.len(textStr) then
lines[#lines] = CUTTAQS_TruncateTextToWidth(lines[#lines], fontName, maxWidth)
end

local totalHeight = (#lines * lineHeight) + math.max(0, (#lines - 1) * compactGap)
if totalHeight <= maxHeight then
bestLayout = {
font = fontName,
lines = lines,
lineHeight = lineHeight,
gap = compactGap,
totalHeight = totalHeight
}
break
end

bestLayout = {
font = fontName,
lines = lines,
lineHeight = lineHeight,
gap = compactGap,
totalHeight = totalHeight
}
end
end

return bestLayout
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawCutsceneDialogue(text, alpha)
text = string.Trim(tostring(text or ""))
alpha = math.Clamp(tonumber(alpha) or 0, 0, 1)
if text == "" or alpha <= 0 then return end

local bottomBarHeight = math.max(tonumber(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.cutsceneBarHeight) or 0, 0)
if bottomBarHeight <= 4 then return end

local horizontalMargin = math.max(36, ScrW() * 0.08)
local verticalMargin = math.max(10, bottomBarHeight * 0.12)
local availableWidth = math.max(160, ScrW() - (horizontalMargin * 2))
local availableHeight = math.max(18, bottomBarHeight - (verticalMargin * 2))
local layout = CUTTAQS_GetCutsceneDialogueLayout(text, availableWidth, availableHeight)
if not layout then return end

local baseY = ScrH() - bottomBarHeight + ((bottomBarHeight - layout.totalHeight) * 0.5)
local textY = math.max(ScrH() - bottomBarHeight + verticalMargin, baseY)
local centerX = ScrW() * 0.5
local shadowAlpha = alpha * 0.7

for _, line in ipairs(layout.lines) do
draw.SimpleText(line, layout.font, centerX + 2, textY + 2, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_BLACK, shadowAlpha), TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
draw.SimpleText(line, layout.font, centerX, textY, CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha), TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_TOP)
textY = textY + layout.lineHeight + layout.gap
end
end

local function CUTTAQS_GetRecurringHudAlpha(prefix, signature, isActive)
local stateKey = prefix .. "CycleState"
local changedAtKey = prefix .. "CycleChangedAt"
local signatureKey = prefix .. "CycleSignature"
local alphaKey = prefix .. "CycleAlpha"
local now = CurTime()

if not isActive then
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] = ""
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0, 0, 8)
return CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0
end

signature = tostring(signature or "")
if CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] ~= signature then
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[signatureKey] = signature
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
end

local cycleState = CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] or "visible"
local stateDuration = cycleState == "visible" and CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_SHOW_TIME or CUTTAQS_PASSIVE_HUD_HIDE_TIME
if now - (CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] or now) >= stateDuration then
cycleState = cycleState == "visible" and "hidden" or "visible"
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[stateKey] = cycleState
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[changedAtKey] = now
end

local targetAlpha = cycleState == "visible" and 1 or 0
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or targetAlpha, targetAlpha, targetAlpha == 1 and 6 or 5)
return CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM[alphaKey] or 0
end

local function CUTTAQS_DrawGlobalGatherCard(x, y, gg)
local isActive = gg and gg.endTime and gg.questname and gg.pos and gg.endTime > CurTime()
CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha = CUTTAQS_AnimateValue(CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha or 0, isActive and 1 or 0, 10)

local gatherSignature = ""
if isActive then
gatherSignature = string.format("%s|%.0f|%.0f|%.0f|%s", tostring(gg.questname), gg.pos.x, gg.pos.y, gg.pos.z, tostring(gg.radius or ""))
end
local cycleAlpha = CUTTAQS_GetRecurringHudAlpha("gather", gatherSignature, isActive)

local alpha = (CUTTAQS_HUD_ANIM.gatherAlpha or 0) * cycleAlpha
if alpha <= 0.02 or not isActive then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 3.2) + 1) * 0.5
local width = math.min(308, ScrW() * 0.235)
local timeLeft = math.max(0, math.ceil(gg.endTime - CurTime()))
local titleLines, titleH = CUTTAQS_WrapText(tostring(gg.questname), "cuttaqs_bankgothic", width - 36, 2)
local height = 68 + (#titleLines * (titleH + 2))
local drawX = x - (1 - alpha) * 24

CUTTAQS_DrawCardShell(drawX, y, width, height, CUTTAQS_COLOR_STEEL, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawHeaderDot(drawX + 18, y + 12, CUTTAQS_COLOR_STEEL, alpha, pulse)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine("RALLY POINT", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_mini", drawX + 30, y + 9, CUTTAQS_COLOR_STEEL, alpha)
local contentY = CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(titleLines, "cuttaqs_bankgothic", drawX + 18, y + 26, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha, 2)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine("Window: " .. tostring(timeLeft) .. "s", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", drawX + 18, contentY + 2, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT_SOFT, alpha)

local radius = tonumber(gg.radius) or 0
if radius > 0 then
local players = player.GetHumans()
local total = #players
local inZone = 0
for _, p in ipairs(players) do
if CUTTAQS_IsPlayerInGatherCircle(p, gg.pos, radius) then
inZone = inZone + 1
end
end

surface.SetMaterial(CUTTAQS_ICON_USER)
surface.SetDrawColor(CUTTAQS_ApplyAlpha(CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha))
surface.DrawTexturedRect(drawX + 18, height + y - 28, 14, 14)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine(string.format("%d/%d on site", inZone, total), "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", drawX + 38, height + y - 28, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha)
end

return height + 8
end

CUTTAQS_IsPlayerInGatherCircle = function(ply, center, radius)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not isvector(center) then return false end
radius = tonumber(radius) or 0
if radius <= 0 then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
pos = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, center.z)
return pos:DistToSqr(center) <= (radius * radius)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

btn:Dock(TOP)
btn:DockMargin(5, 5, 5, 5)

local bg = hovered and Color(62,62,62,230) or Color(42,42,42,215)

surface.DrawOutlinedRect(0,0,w,h,1)

btnLabel:SetText(tostring(option.ActionText or ""))
btnLabel:SetFont("cuttaqs_8bitfont_small")
btnLabel:SetTextColor(Color(255,255,255))

btnLabel:SetAutoStretchVertical(true)
btnLabel:SetContentAlignment(7)

local labelWide = math.max(w - 16, 16)

pan.CQS_LastLabelWide = labelWide
end
btnLabel:SetPos(8, 7)
end

else
btn.DoClick = function()
if cutta_quest_system.Dialogue_Box_Window_frame then
cutta_quest_system.Dialogue_Box_Window_frame:Remove()
cutta_quest_system.Dialogue_Box_Window_frame = nil
end
if cutta_quest_system.Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
if option.ConCommand then
LocalPlayer():ConCommand(option.ConCommand)
end
if option.NextDialogue then
local startnextdia = cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_GetDialogBoxInfo(option.NextDialogue)
if startnextdia.DialogueText then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_OpenDialogBox(startnextdia.DialogueText,startnextdia.Actions,false,option.NextDialogue)
return
end
end
LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber = LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber + 1
if singledialogue == true then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_CL_EndQuestAction()
return
end
if not cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_CanCreateDialogBox() then
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_CameraView_TurnOff()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_CL_EndQuestAction()
end
end
end
end
else
-- Spectators do not auto-close; they follow the starter's updates.

end

if cutta_quest_system.Dialogue_Box_Window_frame then

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
if not cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_CanCreateDialogBox() then
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_CameraView_TurnOff()
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_CL_EndQuestAction()
end
end
end)
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_CanCreateDialogBox(singledialogue)
local check = false
for _, v in ipairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if v.DialogueID == cutta_quest_system:Quests_NPCDialogueSelected(LocalPlayer(),cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(LocalPlayer()),LocalPlayer().temp_CUTTAQS_DialogueNumber) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_OpenDialogBox(v.DialogueText,v.Actions,singledialogue,v.DialogueID)
check = true
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogues_GetDialogBoxInfo(dialogueid)
local dialoguetable = {}
for _, v in ipairs(cutta_quest_system["Dialogues"]) do
if v.DialogueID == dialogueid then
dialoguetable = v
end
end
return dialoguetable
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Dialogue_Start(ply,objdata) --Start Objective Time
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not istable(objdata) then return end
local npcposition = objdata.position or objdata["position"]
local npcangle = objdata.angle or objdata["angle"]
local npcdialogue = objdata.npcdialogue or objdata["npcdialogue"]
local npcmodel = objdata.model or objdata["model"]
local onlyonedialogue = objdata.onlyonedialogue or objdata["onlyonedialogue"] or false
local randomdialogue = objdata.random or objdata["random"] or false
local sequence = objdata.sequence or objdata["sequence"] or ""
local usedianpc = objdata.usedianpc or objdata["usedianpc"]
local usedianpc_id = objdata.usedianpc_id or objdata["usedianpc_id"]
if npcdialogue and npcposition and npcangle then
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and globalId ~= "" and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_GetInstance then
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
local objIndex = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or nil
if inst and objIndex then
inst.spawnedForObj = inst.spawnedForObj or {}
if inst.spawnedForObj[objIndex] then
return
end
inst.spawnedForObj[objIndex] = true
end
end

local NPCDataInfo = {
dialogue = npcdialogue,
singledialogue = onlyonedialogue,
rnddialogue = randomdialogue,
npcpos = npcposition,
npcang = npcangle,
user = ply,
seq = sequence,
dianpc_id = usedianpc_id,
dianpc = usedianpc
}

end

ply.CUTTAQS_DialogueNPC_TalkTo = NPCDataInfo
end

end
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_urlcheck(url)
url = string.Trim(tostring(url or ""))
if url == "" then return false end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_soundpathcheck(soundpath)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return false end

soundpath = string.Trim(tostring(soundpath or ""))
if soundpath == "" then return false end

local soundObject = CreateSound(ply, soundpath)
if not soundObject then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = soundObject
soundObject:Stop()
soundObject:Play()

local duration = SoundDuration(soundpath)
if duration > 0 then
local timerId = soundpath .. "_soundcue_timer"
if timer.Exists(timerId) then timer.Remove(timerId) end
timer.Create(timerId, duration, 1, function()
if IsValid(soundObject) then soundObject:Stop() end
if ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue == soundObject then
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil
end
end)
end

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_playsound(objdata)
local soundPath = objdata and (objdata.sound or objdata["sound"]) or nil
if not soundPath then return end
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

local ply = LocalPlayer()
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil

local function playUrl()
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "noblock", function(station)
if not IsValid(station) then return end
if not IsValid(ply) then
station:Stop()
return
end
station:SetPos(ply:GetPos())
station:Play()
ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = station

local duration = station.GetLength and station:GetLength() or SoundDuration(soundPath) or 0
if duration > 0 then
local timerId = soundPath .. "_soundcue_timer"
if timer.Exists(timerId) then timer.Remove(timerId) end
timer.Create(timerId, duration, 1, function()
if IsValid(station) then station:Stop() end
if ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue == station then ply.CUTTAQS_Soundcue = nil end
end)
end
end)
end

local soundPathStr = string.Trim(tostring(soundPath))
if soundPathStr == "" then return end

if cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_urlcheck(soundPathStr) then
playUrl()
else
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_soundpathcheck(soundPathStr)
end
end
end

end

local json = util.TableToJSON(objdata)

timer.Simple(0,function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)

if not cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame then return end
if not cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab] then return end
cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].QuestMapScrollbar:Clear()
if LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Temp_AllMapQuests_List then
for mapname,v in pairs(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Temp_AllMapQuests_List) do
if mapname == game.GetMap() then continue end
local mapbutton_qs = vgui.Create("DButton",cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame[tab].QuestMapScrollbar)
mapbutton_qs:Dock(TOP)
mapbutton_qs:SetText(cutta_quest_system["Translate"]["Get"](""))
mapbutton_qs.Paint = function(pan,w,h)
draw.RoundedBox(0,0,0,w,h,Color(0,0,0))
if pan:IsHovered() then
draw.RoundedBox(0,0,0,w,h,Color(51,46,46))
end
draw.SimpleText(mapname,"cuttaqs_8bitfont_small",w*0.5,h*0.5,Color(255,255,255),TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER,TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
end
mapbutton_qs.DoClick = function()
if cutta_quest_system:PlayerUserGroupAllowed(LocalPlayer()) != "admin" then return end
local mapselection = DermaMenu()
if istable(v) then
if #v > 0 then
for _, questtable in ipairs(v) do
if istable(questtable) then
local l = next(questtable)
if l then
mapselection:AddOption(l,function()
cutta_quest_system:Quests_CL_AddQuest(LocalPlayer(),questtable)
end)
end
end
end
else
for _, questtable in pairs(v) do
if istable(questtable) then
local l = next(questtable)
if l then
mapselection:AddOption(l,function()
cutta_quest_system:Quests_CL_AddQuest(LocalPlayer(),questtable)
end)
end
end
end
end
end
mapselection:Open()
end
end
end
end
